name: Husqvarna FC / FE / TC / TE (2014 on)
engine: 125 to 510 cc liquid-cooled two- or four-stroke single
intro: The KTM-era Husqvarnas. Shared engines with KTM, a plastic subframe and service intervals measured in hours.

B: FC and FE models are four-strokes. TC, TE and TX models are two-strokes, and older ones run premix. Check which one you have.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Husqvarna dealer to run the VIN as well.
